method.cost: Each new arm adds one bias-free 48-by-48 projection, or 2304 weights at the default width, plus projection work and storage of one intermediate state. Runtime is unmeasured; host costing must cover complete frozen-protocol fits.
method.mechanism: Add an identically initialized, bias-free Linear(hidden, hidden) residual after the incumbent final blend inside encode_sequence. The candidate projects the masked second-block output; the generated control projects the masked seventh-block output. L2-normalize either source, scale by sqrt(hidden), apply the same 0.1 × tanh residual and valid-token mask, and initialize both projections to zero. The source depth is the sole planned architectural contrast.
